tasks.label: Setup LeRobot (Docker + USB)
tasks.detail: HOST: start Docker, share both robot USB cables. Run this BEFORE Reopen in Container.

linux.command: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then echo 'You are inside the container. USB setup runs on the HOST.'; echo 'If ports are missing: Command Palette → Dev Containers: Reopen Folder Locally, then run this task.'; ls -l /dev/ttyACM* /dev/ttyUSB* 2>/dev/null || true; else bash docker/setup.sh --host-prep; fi

tasks.label: Reattach robot USB to Docker
tasks.detail: HOST: run this if /dev/ttyACM* disappeared after unplug.

linux.command: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then echo 'Reattach must run on the HOST, not in this container.'; echo 'Command Palette → Dev Containers: Reopen Folder Locally, then run this task.'; else bash docker/setup.sh --reattach; fi
